chat.t: Hey.
It's me, Rona.
Looks like you already forgot?
Wait! I won't tell you to buy tofu!
At least for now...
Anyway! I'm not trying to force tofu on you, so just help me out.
Oh, come on!
If you keep acting like this, I'll come over and force-feed you tofu!
Have you given it some thought?

o: But why pick me out of all people?

chat.t: Those guys just show off.
Whenever sales are down, they go on and on about marketing... Ugh, as if they know anything.
But at least you actually listen to what I have to say.

o: That's a very long-winded way of saying you just want to show them up...

chat.t: Well, that's part of it.
But really, it'd be great if we could lower the recidivism rate with tofu.

o: As long as I get my commission fee.

lines.t: Tofu Street
Over here!
Yo, long time no s...
Cut the pleasantries. Have a seat.
The reason I called you is none other than...
If it's some trivial nonsense, I'm leaving.
Ugh, I'm telling you, it's really important! Just wait a second.
Sigh... Fine. So, what is it?
You've heard the story about prisoners eating tofu when they get released to start a new life, right?
Of course. Though it's complete nonsense.
It's not baseless. That's just pessimistic talk spread by people who ate terrible tofu.
Sure, let's go with that for now.
Let me finish.
You know that the recidivism rate at Panoticon is insanely high, right?
I've heard of it.
The other day, I was walking down the street and saw some police officers gathered together eating donuts.
So I was about to ask them to try some tofu, but...
They said they wanted to give criminals 'a taste so powerful they'll never commit a crime again.'
When I heard that, it just clicked. So, I got to thinking...
What if we consistently feed a powerful-tasting tofu not just to released prisoners, but also to those still behind bars?
So they can turn over a new leaf even before they get out?
Exactly! They'll be so deeply moved by the incredible tofu that they'll be reborn.
Then they'll never return to Panoticon.
And how exactly do you plan on making that happen?
Well, apparently, the maids in Panoticon held a secret tofu tasting event a few days ago.
And it seems tofu from The Great Tofu Troupe was part of it.
Oh... and how did it turn out?
Our shop's tofu made it into the top five finalists.
The tofu shop that wins the final round gets to regularly supply tofu to Panoticon!
So, if we can perfect our 'powerful-tasting tofu' before then...
We can lower the recidivism rate of Panoticon with tofu, which is great!
And as a bonus, we won't have to bust our humps every day trying to sell a single block of tofu anymore.
Hmm... go on.
The problem is, there's no guarantee we'll win the finals.
What do you have to do to win?
I thought presenting the most delicious tofu made from the rarest soybeans would be enough, but...
I'm a bit worried that alone won't make the taste powerful enough.
And it won't be easy since all the other competitors are aiming for this spot, too.
So basically, you want me to help you secure the official supply contract with Panoticon.
Is this a request to help you win that secret tasting event or whatever?
No, we'll handle that part ourselves.
The part we need your help with is the sales pitch.
Wait, you said you were going to appeal with a powerful taste, so why sales all of a sudden?
After the taste of tofu, the next most important thing is sales!
Developing an intense flavor takes time, so until then, we make up for it with aggressive sales!!
So, you've gotta help me out here!
How the hell did this suddenly become my job?!
I don't know who the judges are or what they look like, but!!
If we pitch it right, we can get every single maid in the Panoticon to subscribe to our tofu!!
And then, they won't even be able to eat a meal without the Great Tofu Troupe's tofu!
And what's your success rate been so far?
The past doesn't matter! What we do from now on is what's important!!
Sigh... This won't be easy.

chat.t: Hey.
Why haven't you reached out yet?
Today is the day you promised to help, you know.
Are you seriously still hesitating?

o: Actually, I was trying to figure out how to say no.

chat.t: Are you kidding me?! Why are you backing out now?!
I figured you'd pull something like this, so I tracked down where you are.
I'm coming in right now!

o: Wait, what?! I was just kidding!!

chat.t: Hey, jailbreaker.
So much for loyalty, running away by yourself.

o: Well, who told you to cause a ruckus in front of the Panoticon in the first place?

chat.t: ...Yeah, that was my fault.
I'm sorry.
And I didn't say a single word about you to the guards.
No need to thank me.

o: I worked my ass off and didn't even get a bonus. Seriously, what is this?

chat.t: I have just one more favor to ask.

o: What could you possibly ask for from here?

chat.t: When I get released tomorrow, bring me a few blocks of tofu.
I can't look my friends in the eye...

o: And what's in it for me?

chat.t: I'll give you a matching set of my worn panties and stockings, so just do it.

o: Fresh tofu, rapid delivery coming right up!

chat.t: He really is a weirdo.

lines.t: Downtown
You really are a high-maintenance friend.
That's it. I'm going to work you twice as hard today.
If it weren't for you, I could've slacked off all day today!
Hey, hey! Don't make me lose my temper like I used to, alright!
Let's start by carrying these tofu samples.
Don't expect any breaks until we hand all of this out today.
Why is there so much?
Do you seriously not know what we're doing today?
We're going to sell tofu in every neighborhood near the Panoticon.
Everywhere those maids' dorms might be!!
Who does things in such a brainless way?! Do we have five bodies?!
Even if we knew cloning magic, that'd be impossible!!
Then what do you suggest? We don't have any info on the judges.
Plus, we'll clash with the local businesses.
What are the two of us gonna do if they pull out weapons and attack?
Don't worry. I brought more than enough tools myself.
Stop whining, grab the tofu, and follow me.
A moment later
Ugh, my back.
...Ugh.
I'm amazed you can walk around so much in those heels.
My feet don't hurt, but my heart does.
I got rejected by so many people...
Maybe my plan was too reckless.
You're just realizing that now?
You really... sigh.
The results aren't great, but we still have a lot of tofu left.
Let's hang in there just a bit longer.
Hold it right there.
I'm going on strike. If I keep carrying tofu like this, my spine is gonna snap.
I can't work. Not over my dead body! I'd rather you send me back to the Panoticon!
...If we finish today, I'll give you any one thing you want as a bonus.
Give me your panties.
Give me your stockings.
What, that's all it takes?
Suit yourself. I'll just give you the ones I'm wearing.
Well, aren't you bold?
To be good at sales, you've gotta be bold.
Oh, that was actually kind of cool. Alright, strike's over. Back to business.
Great. Do your best, okay?
Phew. Only half the tofu left now.
...Or is it that we still have half left?
Tofu Street
The sun's about to set. It's gonna be hard to keep selling.
Let's make this clear. We are not stopping until all of this tofu is handed out.
Oh, damn it. Looks like I'm going back on strike.
I told you I'd give you a bonus!!
That was then, this is now. Give me more.
Ugh, seriously... You, just once—
Huh?
My tofu... My tofu... It's all spilled!
Arghhh, I won't forgive you!!!
Die! Die, you bastards!
...Well, we're screwed. Right in front of the Panoticon too...

chat.t: Whereabouts are you?
I'm getting released today!
"Sorry"? Stop messing around.

o: I forgot. I'm going back to sleep.

chat.t: Hey! Hey!
Do you wanna die?! No bonus for you!

o: Come on, I said I was joking.

chat.t: Hey, jailbreaker.
You know you're surprisingly petty, right?
Still, thanks for helping me out.
You're gonna sell tofu with me next time too, right?
How about a bonus on top of a bonus on top of a bonus?
Hey.
Hey, are you ignoring me??

lines.t: Tofu Street
Phew... It's a perfect day to be released.
Yo!
There you are. Did you bring the tofu?
You know it.
Look how firm it is. As expected of tofu made with soybeans I grew myself.
Here, eat this.
Th-Thank you!
It's protein! Thank you for the food!
Eat slowly, or you'll get indigestion.
Y-Yes, ma'am!
Munch, munch.
Huh? Aren't those the guys we fought last time?
Was the reason you made me bring tofu just to feed them?
Yeah. We shared a cell, so I gave them a little "attitude adjustment."
They're brand new people now.
If they're gonna turn over a new leaf, shouldn't they eat our shop's tofu—the cleanest and most delicious in the world?
Now this is what I call true tofu sales.
You guys!
Eek!
Watch where you're going from now on! And stop breaking people's stuff!
(Both sides were clearly to blame, though.)
If I see you doing that again, I'm coming to teach you another lesson!
Yes, ma'am! Understood!
Now go home.
G-Goodbye!
They ran off so fast.
Are you really okay letting them go like this? They're the ones who ruined your tofu.
...I don't really know.
Still, seeing someone enjoy our shop's tofu feels great after all.
Honestly, I did some thinking while I was in the Panoticon.
Whether I should keep pushing these aggressive sales that always put us in the red.
And?
But in the middle of all that, I felt this burning desire to make those guys taste our tofu no matter what.
At first, I just wanted to show them how precious the tofu they destroyed actually was. But...
Seeing them eat it so happily just now made me realize something.
This is exactly what I wanted to see, and why I've kept selling tofu all this time.
Didn't you basically force-feed them just now?
Could you shut up? Don't ruin my emotional moment.
Anyway, you know that "intense flavor" I talked about before?
I think this might be it.
A taste that's felt with the heart, not the mouth.
So, I'm not gonna overthink it. I'll just keep doing what I've always done!!
You're recklessly optimistic.
But... have you heard anything about the judges for the finals?
Not really. But we've gotta keep selling either way.
Who knows? We might actually end up supplying the Panoticon.
Sure, sure. Break a leg.
I've done my part, so pay up. Give me my commission and my bonus.
What are you talking about? The sales pitch isn't over yet.
Wasn't our agreement to deliver after the sales are completely done?
Sigh... I knew you'd say that.
Hehe. Just suffer with me for one more day.
Then there might be an even bigger bonus waiting for you.
So you're gonna work with me just a little longer, right? Okay?
No way!
